text:
sam: heads-up — reproducible in sample-app: edge runtime crashes when using `require()` in server.ts but README uses `import` 🤔

sam: error:
```text
TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor
    at Object.<anonymous> (/app/node_modules/@redwood/inference/index.js:12:5)
```

sam: repro steps: cloned repo, node 18, vercel edge adapter, env var set `REDWOOD_KEY` per README

maria: hmm — our SDK bundles both CJS and ESM. In edge you must use ESM `import`. Which file uses `require`?

dave: looks like `sample-app/server.js` still uses `const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference')`

olga: also README mentions `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in some spots and `REDWOOD_KEY` in others. That will break auth in examples. :eyes:

maria: can reproduce locally with `vercel dev --edge`

sam: TS also complains in nextjs app: `Module has no default export` when using `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`

ben: workaround: `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` or `const { InferenceClient } = require('@redwood/inference')` depending on build target

maria: we should standardize examples: prefer ESM `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference'` and update README to use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Also add note for edge runtimes: use the ESM entrypoint `@redwood/inference/edge` or set \"type\":\"module\" in package.json

sam: i'll open a small PR to fix sample-app and README, link to it when ready

ben: pls add a tiny test in CI that runs sample-app build with ESM target or a quick `node --input-type=module` sanity check :+1:

devex-bot: created issue #342: "sample-app: mixed require/import + env var mismatch causing edge runtime failure"

maria: assigning to @sam. If you'd like I can review the PR today

sam: Thanks — sending PR in a bit. Will use `import { InferenceClient }` and replace env var everywhere with `REDWOOD_API_KEY` :rocket:

olga: also add a TypeScript snippet showing `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference'` and `const client = new InferenceClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`

sam: will do. closing the loop here when PR lands.
